review.notes: Complete unfiltered functions/tables/views exports reconcile to 91 distinct (schema,name) surfaces. Same-named aliases merge; differently named backing scans remain in denominator, with no authentication/access exclusions. Actual analytical execution uses this public release.

Complete unfiltered functions/tables/views exports reconcile to 91 distinct (schema,name) surfaces. Same-named aliases merge; differently named backing scans remain in denominator, with no authentication/access exclusions. Actual current public SHA catalog was collected. Analytical runs use the release, so matching names/signatures establish correspondence, not exact-current execution. Current metadata clarifies that WNBA playoff_rank is league-wide rather than conference-specific; examples label the returned seed and do not claim a shared ranking population.

review.purpose: Pair two team-game rows before score and shooting-efficiency comparisons.
review.finding: Real recorded four-row response retains two complete games; made-shot points reconcile and effective FG% changes one pair comparison. Margin10→3 retains one game; raw rows remain fixed. Live mode separately reproduced the selected real rows, not substituted into the saved replay.

review.purpose: Separate game, player-game and event grains before applying a local period filter.
review.finding: One final game row provides fixed home/away reference scores. Explicitly fictional API envelope parsed by released worker. Period4→1 changes selected totals14→44 points across leagues; full-game references remain fixed.

review.purpose: Separate game, player-game and event grains before applying a local period filter.
review.finding: Four player rows aggregate to the two scoreboard totals before joining, avoiding duplicated game scores. Explicitly fictional API envelope parsed by released worker. Period4→1 changes selected totals14→44 points across leagues; full-game references remain fixed.

review.purpose: Separate game, player-game and event grains before applying a local period filter.
review.finding: Seven unique action IDs retain repeated action_number and a final missed shot; carried-forward running scores reconcile with scoreboard, while period-filtered made-shot points change. Explicitly fictional API envelope parsed by released worker. Period4→1 changes selected totals14→44 points across leagues; full-game references remain fixed.

review.purpose: Keep metric units and ranking populations explicit.
review.finding: Returned record and seed provide a win-based ordering context; no cross-league seed semantics or full-league balance asserted. Three fictional teams per league; displayed joined metrics and shared-scale figure make the distinction visible. The team context is unchanged by the player eligibility experiment.

review.purpose: Keep metric units and ranking populations explicit.
review.finding: PerGame points and games are joined at league/team/season grain and remain distinct from per-possession rates. Three fictional teams per league; displayed joined metrics and shared-scale figure make the distinction visible. The team context is unchanged by the player eligibility experiment.

review.purpose: Keep metric units and ranking populations explicit.
review.finding: Net rating in points per100 possessions disagrees with win-based seed, while pace is retained separately. Three fictional teams per league; displayed joined metrics and shared-scale figure make the distinction visible. The team context is unchanged by the player eligibility experiment.

review.purpose: Compare rate and sample-size context before filtering a player population.
review.finding: Points per game and games played determine the local eligibility rule. Fictional four-game scorer is excluded at MIN_GAMES5 and included at1; eligible markers6→9 across leagues, underlying rate and rank values fixed.

review.purpose: Compare rate and sample-size context before filtering a player population.
review.finding: True-shooting and usage fractions are joined by player/league/season and kept separate from scoring rate. Fictional four-game scorer is excluded at MIN_GAMES5 and included at1; eligible markers6→9 across leagues, underlying rate and rank values fixed.

review.purpose: Compare rate and sample-size context before filtering a player population.
review.finding: Returned rank, points and games reconcile against the base rate source; provider rank stays visible rather than being relabeled after a local filter. Fictional four-game scorer is excluded at MIN_GAMES5 and included at1; eligible markers6→9 across leagues, underlying rate and rank values fixed.

review.purpose: Resolve a player using league-scoped identity and separate index/roster membership.
review.finding: The full index includes three fictional people; explicit IDs and activity flags are joined within league. All nine index rows remain visible, and Ada Vale ID9001 is selected in each schema without cross-league multiplication.

review.purpose: Resolve a player using league-scoped identity and separate index/roster membership.
review.finding: The active subset excludes one of the three index entries. Its membership column guides identity selection; no claim about current real rosters. All nine index rows remain visible, and Ada Vale ID9001 is selected in each schema without cross-league multiplication.

review.purpose: Resolve a player using league-scoped identity and separate index/roster membership.
review.finding: The season roster is a separate membership relation and selects the named player for the career analysis. All nine index rows remain visible, and Ada Vale ID9001 is selected in each schema without cross-league multiplication.

review.purpose: Count each traded season once and reconcile season and career quantities separately.
review.finding: Mixed team-season and TOT rows demonstrate overlapping grain; selection policies choose two versus three rows per career. Fictional True→False policy experiment changes selected row count6→9 across leagues while canonical career and season totals stay identical.

review.purpose: Count each traded season once and reconcile season and career quantities separately.
review.finding: Independent career endpoint supplies160points/eightgames and exposes the naive260point double count. Fictional True→False policy experiment changes selected row count6→9 across leagues while canonical career and season totals stay identical.

review.purpose: Count each traded season once and reconcile season and career quantities separately.
review.finding: Five later-season game lines sum to100points/fivegames and reconcile with that season, not the complete career. Fictional True→False policy experiment changes selected row count6→9 across leagues while canonical career and season totals stay identical.
